title: Tata Consumer Q4 net profit falls 19% to Rs 217 cr, firm declares dividend of Rs 7.75 per share
caption:
💼 BREAKING: Tata Consumer Q4 net profit falls 19% to Rs 217 cr, firm declares dividend of Rs 7.75 per share

Revenue increased 8.5 percent to Rs 3,927 crore in the three months ended March 31.
